primary_research_question: Is artifact-native format (T11) the true structural driver of the Batch 1 job-post win — generalising across copy angles (operational cost, social proof, classifieds, tax form, chat) — at SQL% >= 25%?
secondary_research_questions: Does milestone+math fusion (T12) lift SQL% above the 6.3% opening-expenses floor to >=15%?
Does the cultural-pride creative survive a fixed LP (T7 mamak)?
Do untested wildcards (gut-punch, metaphor, absurdist, government-form, entertainment-first) earn enough hook rate to justify next-batch slots?

theme_distribution.what_it_learns: Whether artifact format wins across copy angles (job-post, receipt, WhatsApp, Google review, LHDN form) — isolates format from competitive-contrast copy.
Whether fusing a financial anchor inside a milestone moment lifts SQL% above the 6.3% opening-expenses floor.
Whether expanded cultural anchors (mamak, nasi lemak) replicate the kopitiam scroll-stop now that LP is being audited.
Whether forensic cost breakdown in an unexpected metaphor lands without falling into the failed standalone-math trap.
Whether emotional gut-punch survives the artifact wrapper — gives T1 its first real RM50+ runway.

pre_launch_gates.gate: Kopitiam LP audit complete — confirm form fires, mobile renders, pixel attributes correctly
Lead-form revenue-band qualifier field deployed on milestone-themed LPs
Verify the '552 hours / year on manual reconciliation' figure for C_005 against a defensible source (avg 46h/mo × 12 = 552h). If actual MY merchant data exists, prefer it.

Verify C_001 receipt line-items (manual reconciliation 46h × RM25, stock write-offs RM 680, overtime 3-staff RM 1,890, missed loyalty RM 220) against MY merchant benchmarks or labour-cost data — must be defensible if questioned in comments.
C_007 LHDN form artwork — legal + brand review for Meta deceptive-content policy and LHDN-impersonation risk; add 'illustrative — not a real LHDN document' microcopy bottom-right.
PH RM0 status documented — pause vs delivery break — does not block MY launch but must be resolved

per_concept_qa_gates.qa_check: WhatsApp UI realism — fonts, bubble shape, timestamp format, read receipts, group avatar all native-accurate at 2-sec glance. Reviewer: design lead.
Google review chrome realism — star colour, profile placement, verified badge, owner-response styling, font weights match current Google Maps mobile UI.

LHDN form realism — letterhead, serial number formatting, checkbox grid, font (typically Arial/Times) match real LHDN documents at 2-sec glance — without being mistakable for an actual government form. Microcopy disclaimer present and legible.

anti_recycling_check: Visual format spread: 5 artifact concepts (C_001 receipt, C_002 WhatsApp, C_003 Google review, C_007 LHDN form, C_011 job-post) — deliberate, testing T11 format generalisation across five distinct copy angles as required by the primary research question. Balance: 2 typography-led milestone math, 2 cultural photography, 1 metaphor (coin-stack), 1 emotional documentary. No format is recycling a Batch 1 loser; each artifact rides a different copy angle so the result decomposes cleanly.

concepts.name: artifact-receipt-hidden-cost
concepts.hook_visual: Full-bleed photo of a crumpled month-end expense statement on a coffee-stained table. Line items legible: 'Manual reconciliation (46h × RM25/h) RM 1,150 | Stock write-offs RM 680 | Staff overtime (3 staff) RM 1,890 | Missed loyalty redemptions RM 220 | StoreHub POS RM 408.' Last line circled in red pen.
concepts.headline: Which one are you cutting?
concepts.sub_headline: Your month, itemised. The cheapest line is the one that quietly fixes the other four.
concepts.target_segment: MY F&B + retail owners, monthly revenue RM30k+, operating manual back-of-house
concepts.hypothesis: We believe MY F&B owners will engage with a receipt-style artifact because it forces calculation of an unquantified operational cost, so SQL% will match or beat job-post (28.6%) without using competitive-contrast copy.
concepts.unique_lever: Artifact format applied to T9 hidden-cost copy (proves format isolation from T5 copy)

concepts.name: artifact-whatsapp-1am-boss
concepts.hook_visual: Vertical screenshot of a WhatsApp group chat. Group name 'Restaurant Ops'. Timestamps 00:47–01:12. Boss messages: 'Stock count off again?' Staff: 'Three tablets all showing different numbers.' Boss: 'Tomorrow we look at StoreHub lah.' Authentic WhatsApp UI down to read receipts.
concepts.headline: When the group chat starts at midnight, it's time.
concepts.sub_headline: One POS. One inventory. One source of truth across every location.
concepts.body_or_bullets: Real-time stock | Auto-reconciled sales | From RM3.40/day
concepts.target_segment: Multi-tablet/multi-location F&B owners in Klang Valley
concepts.hypothesis: We believe multi-location MY F&B owners will read past line 1 of a fake WhatsApp screenshot because the artifact mimics native content they read 100x/day, so CPSQL will beat control by 10%+.
concepts.unique_lever: Artifact format in 1080x1920 long-form chat (untested aspect ratio for T11)

concepts.name: artifact-google-review-binq
concepts.hook_visual: Full Google review card UI — 5 orange stars, reviewer 'Binq Dessert (4 locations)', verified badge, profile photo. Review text: 'Cut closing time from 2 hours to 20 minutes. Manpower down by 2 staff per shift. Switched in 2024, never looked back.' Two thumbs-up emojis from 'Owner response: StoreHub'.
concepts.headline: Real merchant. Real numbers. Real switch.
concepts.sub_headline: Binq cut closing time by 83%. From RM3.40/day. Book a demo and we'll show you the maths.
concepts.target_segment: MY F&B owners actively comparing POS solutions (late-stage)
concepts.hypothesis: We believe late-stage prospects will trust a Google-review artifact more than a brand testimonial because the format itself is the credibility cue, so Win% will lift vs control.
concepts.unique_lever: Artifact format applied to T6 social-proof with real merchant data — gives T6 its first RM50+ runway

concepts.name: milestone-opening-week-itemised
concepts.hook_visual: Clean typography on cream BG. Vertical itemised list styled like an architect's budget sheet: 'Renovation RM48,000 / Kitchen equipment RM25,000 / Signage RM3,500 / Staff training RM4,000 / POS from RM3.40/day (highlighted in orange).' D3 Pro hardware floating bottom-right at quarter scale.
concepts.headline: You saved where it counts.
concepts.sub_headline: Opening week is the most expensive week of your career. The POS shouldn't be the line that breaks you.
concepts.target_segment: MY F&B owners 0–90 days from opening, Klang Valley
concepts.hypothesis: We believe opening-stage merchants will self-qualify when the milestone (opening week) is paired with verifiable cost lines because the comparison forces affordability calculation in-creative, lifting SQL% above the 6.3% opening-expenses floor.
concepts.success_metric: SQL% >= 15%; CPSQL <= RM400; lead-form revenue-band field populated >80%
concepts.unique_lever: Milestone+math fusion in typography-led format (no artifact wrapper, no photo)

concepts.name: milestone-year2-time-math
concepts.hook_visual: Split layout. Left half black BG, white type: 'Year 1: 552 hours counting stock by hand.' Right half orange BG, black type: 'Year 2 with StoreHub: 0.' Thin divider in the middle. No product shot — numbers carry it.
concepts.headline: Which year are you closing?
concepts.sub_headline: You can't get the hours back. But you can stop bleeding them.
concepts.body_or_bullets: Auto-reconciled sales | Daily report at close | From RM3.40/day
concepts.target_segment: MY F&B + retail owners 10–18 months in, owner-operator, manual back-of-house
concepts.hypothesis: We believe owners past the survival window will engage with a time-cost milestone (hours bled in Year 1) more than a money-cost one because once a business is past month 12 the constraint is operator burnout, not cashflow, so SQL% will exceed 18%.
concepts.success_metric: SQL% >= 18%; CPSQL <= RM350; lead-form revenue-band field populated >80%
concepts.unique_lever: Year-2 anniversary milestone using time-cost not money-cost (untested time-horizon, untested unit-of-loss)

concepts.name: cultural-mamak-night
concepts.hook_visual: Full-bleed authentic photo: a mamak stall after midnight, fluorescent lighting, plates of roti canai stacked, owner at the till. D3 POS visible but not the hero. Slight motion blur on a customer walking past.
concepts.headline: Your stall. Our tech.
concepts.sub_headline: Built for the way Malaysian F&B actually runs — 11pm rushes, cash + QR, every payment in one screen.
concepts.body_or_bullets: DuitNow | Boost | TnG | Cash | One POS
concepts.hypothesis: We believe mamak owners will scroll-stop on culturally specific imagery for the same reason kopitiam earned 64 clicks, and with the LP audit fixed the clicks will convert to leads at CPL <= RM70.
concepts.unique_lever: Cultural anchor expanded beyond kopitiam (new cultural execution)

concepts.name: artifact-lhdn-tax-form
concepts.hook_visual: First second: viewer sees what appears to be an LHDN tax form mid-scroll. Official-looking serial number, government letterhead, checkbox grid. Single highlighted line: 'Item 14: Annual hours your team spent on manual end-of-day reconciliation (hrs): ________'. Pen hovering over the blank. Microcopy bottom-right: 'illustrative — not a real LHDN document'.
concepts.headline: If LHDN audited your time, you'd cry.
concepts.sub_headline: StoreHub closes your day in 12 minutes. The hours you actually want back.
concepts.body_or_bullets: Auto-reconciled sales | Daily report at close | Setup in 24h
concepts.target_segment: MY F&B + retail owners, owner-operator, manual end-of-day
concepts.hypothesis: We believe MY merchants will read a fake LHDN form before realising it's an ad because tax forms are read with maximum attention, so the artifact wrapper will lift SQL% above 20% even with no merchant in the visual.
concepts.success_metric: SQL% >= 20%; not mistaken for a real government form by >5% of viewers (audited via comment monitoring)
concepts.unique_lever: Government-form artifact (highest-attention native document, never tested)

concepts.name: absurd-nasi-lemak-pos-stack
concepts.hook_visual: Surreal still life: a single banana leaf with nasi lemak, sambal, peanuts, ikan bilis, and one boiled egg — but instead of the egg, a tiny D3 POS terminal sits in the egg's place, perfectly proportioned, steam rising. Hyperreal food photography lighting.
concepts.headline: Standard issue. Malaysian F&B.
concepts.sub_headline: The five things every stall needs. We're the one nobody told you about.
concepts.body_or_bullets: From RM3.40/day | DuitNow + QR | Built for Malaysian F&B
concepts.target_segment: MY F&B owners, broad — pure scroll-stop play
concepts.hypothesis: We believe an absurd visual juxtaposition will earn 2x the hook rate of literal product photography because pattern interruption beats pattern recognition, lifting CTR above 1.5% even if SQL% sits at batch average.
concepts.success_metric: CTR >= 1.5%; hook rate (3-sec view) >= 0.8%; CPL <= RM80
concepts.unique_lever: Surreal visual metaphor — product not shown literally, food as cultural carrier

concepts.name: metaphor-coin-stack-leaking
concepts.hook_visual: Frozen mid-dissolve — bottom coins half-transformed into stylised smoke wisps, captured at peak visual tension. Single still frame, no motion implied beyond the visual metaphor. Macro shot, dark BG: a tall stack of RM coins, the bottom 5 fixed in a half-coin/half-smoke morph. No product visible. Single line of small text bottom: 'Manual reconciliation: 46 hrs. Stock write-offs: untracked. Overtime pay: untracked.' Orange StoreHub H-mark bottom-right corner.
concepts.headline: Where your month goes.
concepts.sub_headline: The costs you don't see are the ones that close businesses. StoreHub closes the leaks.
concepts.target_segment: MY F&B + retail owners running manual back-of-house
concepts.hypothesis: We believe a pure visual metaphor (coins dissolving) will outperform literal cost breakdowns on hook rate because metaphor compresses meaning into 1 second, while still landing the operational-leak insight that T9 needs to test.
concepts.success_metric: Hook rate (3-sec view) >= 1.0%; CPL <= RM80; gives T9 its first RM50+ runway
concepts.unique_lever: Pure visual metaphor — no copy in first second, no product, money-as-smoke imagery

concepts.name: gutpunch-2am-empty-stall
concepts.hook_visual: Documentary still, no music suggestion: a small F&B stall at 2:14am (timestamp burnt-in lower corner). Owner alone at a folding table under a single fluorescent tube, paper receipts spread out, calculator, eyes closed, hand on forehead. No product visible. No StoreHub branding until the final 1.5 seconds.
concepts.headline: Tomorrow you do it again.
concepts.sub_headline: Or you don't. StoreHub closes your day in 12 minutes, not 2 hours.
concepts.body_or_bullets: Auto-reconciled sales | Daily report at close | From RM3.40/day
concepts.target_segment: MY F&B owners running solo close-outs, owner-operator stalls
concepts.hypothesis: We believe a quiet documentary image of a real merchant moment (not chaos, not stock — just exhaustion) will land harder than the 'tablets everywhere' execution from Batch 1 because recognition is stronger than dramatisation, lifting MQL rate above 85%.
concepts.success_metric: MQL rate >= 85%; CPL <= RM75; gives T1 its first RM50+ runway in artifact-adjacent wrapper
concepts.unique_lever: Emotional gut-punch — raw, no humour, no product visible until reveal

concepts.name: artifact-jobpost-impossible-human
concepts.hook_visual: JobStreet-style classifieds card, exactly mimicking the platform UI. Title: 'HIRING: One Human (must be 4 humans).' Requirements list (12 bullets): manages POS, inventory, loyalty, daily reports, staff schedules, customer SMS, refunds, multi-location stock sync, end-of-day reconciliation, shift handovers, never sleeps, never gets sick — for RM900/month. Salary line crossed out. Final line: 'OR: StoreHub. From RM3.40/day.'
concepts.headline: Hiring: one human (must be four humans).
concepts.sub_headline: The job description nobody can fill. The system that already does it.
concepts.body_or_bullets: POS + inventory + loyalty + reports + reconciliation | One screen | RM3.40/day
concepts.target_segment: MY F&B + retail owners, owner-operator, currently hiring
concepts.hypothesis: We believe escalating the proven job-post artifact into absurdist territory (impossible requirements) will preserve the 28.6% SQL% AND lift CTR by adding humour to the structural format, so CPSQL falls below RM300.
concepts.unique_lever: Absurdist evolution of the proven job-post format — tests if humour amplifies or dilutes the structural win

concepts.name: entertainment-90day-survival-clock
concepts.hook_visual: Single locked-off shot: a wall clock with a Post-it stuck on it that says 'Day 47 of 90'. Behind the clock, slightly out of focus, a half-renovated restaurant. The second hand audibly ticks for 2 seconds before any text appears. Then a single line slides in.
concepts.headline: The first 90 days decide the next 10 years.
concepts.sub_headline: Your POS is the cheapest line on the rescue list. From RM3.40/day.
concepts.target_segment: MY F&B owners 30–90 days into their first business
concepts.hypothesis: We believe an entertainment-first hook (clock + silence + Post-it) will earn 3-sec view rates 2x higher than a numbers-first milestone math execution because tension builds attention, then delivers the same math payload at second 3.
concepts.unique_lever: Entertainment-first pacing — visual tension before any text, milestone math arrives as the punchline
